title: James Sunderland's final choice in Silent Hill 2
subject: james
description:
Which Silent Hill 2 ending do you think is the real one? 👇

Why Pyramid Head hunted James Sunderland, and how he finally faced his guilt. Spoilers for Silent Hill 2 and its endings.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami or Bloober Team. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: James Sunderland's executioner was something he created himself.
Pyramid Head stalked him across Silent Hill. It was never a random monster.
It was born from his guilt, the punishment James believed he deserved for Mary's death.
But that's not how it ends. James finally admits he was weak, that he needed someone to punish him, and that he doesn't anymore.
His executioners fall by their own hand. Then James faces Mary one last time.
In the Leave ending, he reads her true letter, takes young Laura's hand, and chooses to live. He stopped running from the monster he made.
